_comment: M2: i_cascade = 10 (workbook fission default 20).  The M1 ladder showed
mean_n_111 saturates at ~21 across i_mobile = 5..100 and is IDENTICAL with
LOOP_COAL on or off at i_mobile >= 50 -- two independent ways of lifting the
coalescence restriction converge on one ceiling, so neither is the limiter.
n ~ 21 against i_cascade = 20 is the coincidence under test.
PREDICTION, stated before the run: if mean_n_111 tracks i_cascade, <111> size
is inherited from the cascade source rather than grown.  If it stays ~21, the
source is not the limiter either and the ceiling is kinetic.
